authorization: User approved the ETF-index relative-price measurability and pseudo-reversion screen, not a reversion outcome or trading experiment.
access: Read exactly ten index 1m annual partitions for the two maps and 2021-2025, ten existing ETF annual CSVs, two action CSVs, the pinned manifests and source audit. Inventory other repository DATA PATHS only; do not read MO, 3s prices, R1 outcome ledgers or 2026 prices.
estimand: Observability, tick granularity and magnitude of label-coincident consecutive-minute ETF-minus-index log price changes. NOT a level premium, true NAV deviation, excess alpha, causal mispricing or subsequent repair.

time.index_parse: Inherit original market reader's first-19-character Shanghai wall-clock mapping, cross-check trading_day; report its provenance limitation rather than optimize a shift.
time.etf_parse: Use explicit timezone-aware canonical CSV timestamps; reject naive values.
time.join: exact timestamp only; index reference clock
time.eligible_comparison: Adjacent index records exactly 60 seconds apart, same day and same declared session, finite positive index closes and valid positive-volume ETF OHLCV at both endpoints. Exclude the full action ex-date from this diagnostic. Report every exclusion and all extras.
time.positive_volume_is: a positive-volume vendor record, not proof of synchronous trades, executable quotes or absence of vendor error
time.unchanged_positive_close_is: a descriptive repeat, not proof of staleness

formulas.tick_bp: 10000*0.001/ETF_prev; dimensional reference only, NOT a spread, observation-error bound or profit threshold
formulas.grid_check: For all finite positive ETF OHLC, abs(price/0.001-round(price/0.001))<=1e-6. Off-grid counts retained, not rounded away.
formulas.same_minute_range_bp: 10000*(ETF_high-ETF_low)/ETF_close, descriptive trade range NOT synchronous quote uncertainty
formulas.gap_to_tick: absolute_change_gap_bp/tick_bp; <=1 reference tick fraction reported, no candidate selection

summaries.groups: each carrier pooled, each calendar year, each calendar month; identical predeclared rules
counts: adjacent 60s comparisons and mutually exclusive rejection reasons
diagnostics: available source columns and missing observation fields

identification_test: Construct deterministic synthetic observational-equivalence examples: identical ETF OHLCV and sampled index values can arise from trade-price bid/ask bounce around unchanged fair value OR a changing efficient price. Likewise a sampled relative discrepancy can be ETF off fair value OR an index/reference publication lag. No hidden mechanism is identified merely by the minute columns.

gates.L0: Byte identity, schema, timestamp-label parsing and numerical summaries; conditional on inherited source semantics.
gates.L1: Synchronous economically meaningful relative deviation additionally requires documented within-bar trade/index as-of times and ETF quote or efficient-price/reference evidence. NAV premium further requires source-backed contemporaneous IOPV/basket/cash/action valuation with publication times and limitations; IOPV alone is not perfect NAV.
gates.L2: Reversion, repair-side, lead-lag and execution outcomes are outside this screen and never opened.
gates.stop: If L1 is not identifiable from the admitted delivery, finish L0 diagnostics and report a minimal external-data contract. Do not declare all observed gaps artifacts or search longer horizons/thresholds to evade the limitation. No new acquisition/purchase or empirical candidate automatically follows.

prohibitions: no R1_A event conditioning or revival
no autocorrelation or future markout/repair test
no z-score entry or threshold search
no new source purchase or credential use
source_semantics_limit: Pinned local source audit lists DataHub time-contract references and action-source summaries, but these are not independently inspected exchange messages. Report declared vs verified separately.
budget: One deterministic measurement pass, synthetic boundary tests and read-only reproduction. No adaptive candidate/method selection.
